detail: Publisher original: The Journal of Symbolic Logic 50(2), June 1985, pp. 510-530 (ASL page scan, (c) 1985 Association for Symbolic Logic, 0022-4812/85/5002-0025; ResearchGate 'View publication stats' footer appended on last page). 21 PDF pages = printed pp. 510-530 continuous (p. 528 is the full-page implication diagram, image only); complete from abstract and Section 1 through Observation 4.10, references and author affiliations.

Publisher original: Information Processing Letters Vol. 8 No. 3, March 1979, pp. 121-123 (Elsevier page scan, PII 0020-0190(79)90002-4). 3 PDF pages = printed pp. 121-123 continuous; full text through algorithm Steps 1-5 and references.

Publisher's version (Radboud Repository cover sheet: 'Version of the following full text: Publisher's version'); scan of Handbook of Logic in Computer Science vol. 2 (Abramsky, Gabbay, Maibaum eds.), 1992. 194 PDF pages: p.1 repository cover sheet, then printed pp. 117-309 continuous (193 pages; p.117 contents, p.118 Introduction ... references ending p.309). The entry record says pp. 118--310, but the repository record and the printed folios both give 117-309 (off-by-one in the entry record; the whole chapter is present, incl. PTS definition and lambda-cube section). Coq/Rocq and Lean kernel definitions named in the units are separate sources, not part of this work.

Original 1936 publication: Annals of Mathematics, Second Series, Vol. 37 No. 4, October 1936 (microfilm scan of the whole issue, Internet Archive sim_ periodicals). Whole-issue PDF, 205 pages. The article is PDF pages 79-99 = printed pp. 823-843, every folio present and continuous; begins with title/byline (Received April 4, 1936) on p. 823 and ends with the Appendix and author affiliations on p. 843; next article (S. Robinson) starts on PDF p. 100. Other articles of the issue are also in the file.

Authors' TeX-generated book file (PDF creator ' TeX output 1996.10.07:1554', MiKTeX dvipdfmx, PDF dated 2012) posted on Gurevich's homepage; title page reads Springer-Verlag but there is no copyright/imprint page, series page or publication year; not the Springer 1997 printed edition. 489 PDF pages: title, Preface VII-VIII, Contents IX-XII, then body pp. 1-482 continuous (printed folio = PDF page - 7 from PDF p.9 to end; unnumbered pages are chapter openers/blank versos). 6.2.1 Monadic Formulae p.256, 6.2.2 Bernays-Schonfinkel-Ramsey Class p.264, 6.2.3 Godel-Kalmar-Schutte Class p.268, 6.3.2 Ackermann Class p.288 all present in full. Pagination matches the 1997 Springer book (482 pp.), but textual identity with the printed edition cannot be confirmed from this file.

Original 1908 publication: Tijdschrift voor Wijsbegeerte, Tweede Jaargang, Amsterdam: W. Versluys / Leiden: Brill, 1908 (full-volume scan, Univ. of Toronto Robarts copy; IA catalogues the serial as "Algemeen Nederlands tijdschrift voor wijsbegeerte"). Whole-volume PDF, 626 pages. The article is PDF pages 162-168 = printed pp. 152-158, continuous; begins with title/byline on p.152, ends on p.158, next article (Pekelharing, Teleologische beoordeeling) begins p.159; volume contents lists "De onbetrouwbaarheid der logische principes door L. E. J. Brouwer 152". Original Dutch only: the separately qualified translation named in the extent is not part of this source and still has to be acquired separately.
